name: Cable Seated Reverse Fly
steps: Sit on a bench centered between two low pulleys and grip the opposite handles.
Hinge forward over your thighs with a flat back so your hands hang below your chest.
Raise both arms out to the sides with softly bent elbows until they align with your shoulders.
Pause briefly, then lower the handles back beneath your chest under control.
tips: Hold your torso angle steady throughout the fly.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
